module.title: Days 1–10 | Foundation Module
module.description: First ten complete lessons; prepared for admin review before production publishing.

lessons.title: Baseline & digital/skill awareness
lessons.objective: Identify current ability, target outcomes and safe, effective learning habits.
lessons.core_teaching_content: This practical lesson develops baseline & digital/skill awareness within Public Speaking. Demonstrate the skill first, then break it into small actions. Learners repeat the process with guided support and finally complete a realistic task independently.
examples: Demonstration example: Tutor completes the task while naming each step.
Guided example: Learner performs the task with prompts and checks.
Independent example: Learner completes the same outcome using their own workflow.
lessons.practical_activity: Hands-on practice: observe → imitate → adapt → produce.
lessons.guided_practice: Learner repeats the demonstrated workflow while the tutor checks each key step.
lessons.independent_practice: Complete one realistic task without step-by-step prompting and submit the result.
questions: What is the purpose of this skill?
What are the essential steps?
What common mistake should you avoid?
How will you check the quality of your result?
lessons.assessment_checkpoint: Practical demonstration scored for correctness, completeness, clarity and independence.
lessons.student_task: Create or complete one small real-world output using today's skill and document the steps you followed.
lessons.tutor_guidance: Demonstrate once clearly, then reduce support; assess the process as well as the final output.
lessons.reflection_completion: Record one skill I can perform independently and one part where I still need guided practice.
